reviews.text: Loved the experience, Maria was really friendly and her service was amazing!
I came with some friends for trivia night- I have celiac disease and our server Maria was so helpful in guiding me through the menu! She was so friendly and knowledgeable!
Maria was helpful and efficient in getting food and drinks for us👍
Maria is a great server! She usually takes care of our tables and is always very friendly and attentive.
Maria offered us amazing service. We’re regulars and would like to see new options added to the menu.
Came by for some drinks and a quick bite and had the pleasure of having Maria as our server! She was so sweet and kind! I recommend asking for her on your next visit!
Maria is an excellent bartender. Very attentive.
Maria did a wonderful job. The food was on point, and for a place we could walk to while visiting, we were impressed. Great job!
Our sever Ewan was excellent on every level. I see him being future management material.

Ewan was fantastic!
Very friendly, knowledgeable and attentive.
Ewan was a great server today for us and made great small talk

Ewan and Michael were incredible servers tonight. One of our best experiences at Local. Ewan asked each guest their name and used it throughout the night. Michael checked in regularly to see if we had everything. Local is such a great spot.
Ewan was great! He was able to accommodate every single ask we had in no time and always with a smile.

I had the pleasure of dining here for my Fiancé’s God-daughter’s first birthday, the service and atmosphere was so wonderful we decided to reach out to book a large party for our Engagement party, the booking process was so easy - even for a 60 person party. Nicky and the team were quick to address all inquiries, provided a detailed event deck so we knew what to expect on the day of our party. Unfortunately we had to cancel due to my fiance needing surgery for a broken leg but the team was so wonderful to work with, I will definitely be reaching out to reschedule the celebration once he has healed. 10/10 service, vibes, food was great and overall amazing experience.
Daniel was an amazing! He was very friendly, attentive, and made sure we had everything we needed. His service made our experience even better. Highly recommend!
Daniel was amazing
Daniel is the best server I’ve ever had in my life. Like ever. Beer was never empty, food was never cold. I love Daniel.

Daniel was amazing. I was always taken care of and he made sure we had a good time.
Daniel deserves it all!
Had such a great time with my family at Local. Our server Daniel was amazing and made sure we had everything we needed and more!
Daniel was great
Thanks to Daniel for great serving!
Our server Harrison was great, kept checking out table and was very kind to the kids!
love dining at local! Derks is the sweetest the server ever!
Derks was the best server ever!!! She made our experience so fun! So efficient and will definitely be coming back soon because of her!
Derks is an amazing server. Huge smile, friendly, and great attitude. Awesome fish tacos with a very nice patio.
Derks is an amazing server. Friendly, knowledgeable, and recommend ex the Ahi Tina Pole Bowl which was awesome. Great brand ambassador for your restaurant.

We had a wonderful experience at The Local in Leaside. The atmosphere was warm and welcoming, and the food was fresh, flavourful and beautifully presented. Special thanks to our server, Kaia, who made the evening even better. She was friendly, attentive, and genuinely made us feel well looked after without ever being intrusive. You can tell the staff takes pride in creating a great dining experience. We’ll definitely be back
